rationale: Proposition is explicit and falsifiable: specifies rates and ranges per family with clear computation rules.
Strong numeric reproducibility (max relative error 2.84e-15) confirms dataset values are stable.
Metric match and notation match pass; usable values extracted without truncation.
Claim is correctly framed as dataset-level observation, not a universal mathematical theorem.
Falsification rule based on recomputation from source ensures testability.
critical_risks: Risk of misinterpretation as a general mathematical truth beyond the dataset.
Dependent on the integrity of the source file and schema consistency.
Empirical rates may change with different data or experimental conditions.
notes: Approve as dataset-specific empirical claim. For publication, clearly label as observational and include access to source data for verification.
